purpose: Concise professor-facing overview; detailed state inventories remain in the plan and existing UI page.

cases.title: 06 · Review a service request
cases.heading: Review your request
cases.body: Check the selected service, requirements and fee before submitting.

fields.label: Fee
fields.value: Free or the selected type’s configured amount

fields.label: Details and evidence
fields.value: Your entered details and required files

notes: The server validates the current fee and requirements. Pending declaration blocks submission. Repeated taps create one reference.
Paid requests use eGovPay or teller-confirmed cash; processing starts after authoritative payment. Office receives a committed submission live.

cases.title: 07 · Ready for physical pickup
cases.heading: Ready for pickup
cases.body: Claim this request to get your pickup code.
notes: Office marks Ready → this student screen updates live. Ready alone generates no QR.
Claim checks ownership, status and payment. An unconfigured expiry or failed check leaves the request Ready with retry.

cases.title: 08 · Student pickup QR
cases.heading: Show this at pickup
cases.body: Staff reviews your code and confirms the handover.
notes: Claim generates or retrieves one valid server code. Reopening reuses it until expiry or invalidation.
Scan or manual entry → authorized office review → explicit handover confirmation → Completed on both sides live.

cases.title: 09 · Digital document receipt
cases.heading: Your PDF result
cases.body: Download the released PDF, then confirm receipt.
notes: Office verifies/releases the PDF → student receives Ready for Download live.
Confirm receipt enables only after successful download of the released version. Confirmation completes both sides; failed download does not.

cases.title: 13 · Authorized office workspace
cases.heading: Manage your office
cases.body: Review assigned work and update students in real time.

fields.label: Inbox and consultations
fields.value: Reply to inquiries · manage permitted schedules

notes: Committed submissions and inquiries arrive in the assigned office’s queue/inbox live.
Staff processes eligible requests and marks physical results Ready or releases verified PDFs. Faculty/Guidance manage their schedules; CCS secretary has assigned coordination access.

cases.title: 14 · Office confirms handover
cases.heading: Review before handover
cases.body: Check the matching request before handing over the result.

fields.label: Pickup validation
fields.value: Eligible code · scan or manual entry

notes: Scanning only validates. The authorized office confirms the actual handover.
Server consumes the code and completes once. Wrong-office, expired, used or invalid codes are rejected. Completion updates student and office live.

cases.title: 15 · Cashiering payment confirmation
cases.heading: Review cash payment
cases.body: Check the request and received amount before confirming.
notes: Only an authorized teller confirms the exact amount once. Student and responsible office update live.
Free requests skip payment. eGovPay uses trusted callback/reconciliation after contract approval; browser return never proves payment.
